title: jnwb.omission_identity used the unit_id column instead of row-position identity in 4 functions -- fixed, headline conclusion unchanged

generated.summary: build_noise_controlled_spike_matrix, build_noise_controlled_spike_matrix_with_subblocks, decode_identity_cycle_deconfound, and decode_time_from_features all built unit_ids = units_df['unit_id'].tolist() and passed those values into session.get_spike_times(). get_spike_times's primary lookup is by raw DataFrame row position (see spiking-fact-unit-row-position-identity), not the per-probe-local kilosort 'unit_id' column, which can have gaps. A column value equal to another row's position silently returned that OTHER unit's real spike train -- the exact collision already documented and fixed in jnwb/trajectory.py (sub-C31o_ses-230816_rec, PFC row 3 vs unit_id column 4.0, 3470 vs 449 spikes) but never propagated to this sibling module. jnwb/unit_classification.py and jnwb/structured_identity_m2a.py (the approved Milestone 2A path) were already correct. Fixed all 4 call sites to use units_df.index.tolist().

links.reasoning: That node's verification scope (source_paths: jnwb/spiking.py, jnwb/trajectory.py) did not cover this sibling module, which had the bug the fact describes.

That audit validated decode_identity_cycle_deconfound's grouped-CV/permutation design as one of two valid Figure 4 paths without checking its unit-identity resolution; this node adds that missing check.

notes: Only 3 scripts reach the buggy functions: scripts/historical/confounded/compute_omission_identity_encoding{,_v2}.py (already quarantined by directory convention) and scripts/compute_omission_identity_cycle_deconfound_v3.py (live, the source of the PROJECT_STATE.md 'cycle-deconfounded ~ chance, do not promote 0.601' headline).

Full-corpus rerun post-fix (22 sessions x 7 areas, 60/154 cells succeeded, n_permutations=200, seed=42): mean LOCO accuracy (mean-centered) = 0.4960, 6/60 cells nominally significant at p<0.05 -- unchanged in substance from the pre-fix ~0.495 figure cited in agent-harness-audit-20260810.json. The chance-level conclusion in PROJECT_STATE.md Figure 4 holds; it is now verified on a corrected identity basis rather than a coincidentally-similar buggy one.

A true pre-fix full-corpus CSV was not preserved (the pre-existing outputs/classification/omission_identity_cycle_deconfound_p2.csv, dated 2026-08-06, was inadvertently overwritten by a 1-session sanity-check run before it could be copied aside). The ~0.495 comparison figure is taken from the prior agent's own written receipt (agent-harness-audit-20260810.json), not a byte-level CSV diff -- flagged as a provenance gap, not hidden.

decode_omission_identity_slot and decode_omission_identity_full (both already self-flagged scientific_status='invalid_for_inference' for an unrelated ungrouped-CV reason) consume unit_ids returned by build_noise_controlled_spike_matrix / build_noise_controlled_spike_matrix_with_subblocks, including decode_omission_identity_full's own R-null-stratum loop -- so both are fixed transitively by the 4 call-site edits, with no separate unit_id-column usage of their own. Verified by re-reading both functions end to end after the edit.

commands: pytest -q  (400 passed, 2 failed [pre-existing, unrelated stale harness-shape test], 44 skipped)

predictive_state.expected_behavior: get_spike_times() called from jnwb.omission_identity is now always given a row-position argument; no downstream test or full-suite regression introduced.
